cards.ex: I always shop around online before buying anything expensive.
cards.exUz: Men qimmat narsa sotib olishdan oldin har doim internetda narxlarni solishtiraman.
cards.uzDef: Turli do'konlarda bir xil narsaning narxini solishtirish.

cards.ex: We went window shopping downtown to kill some time.
cards.exUz: Biz vaqt o'tkazish uchun shahar markazida vitrina tomosha qildik.
cards.uzDef: Do'konlarni tomosha qilish, lekin hech narsa sotib olmaslik.

cards.ex: That candy bar was an impulse buy; I didn't even want it.
cards.exUz: Bu konfet spontan xarid bo'ldi; men uni hatto xohlamagan edim.

cards.ex: These shoes are on sale this week, so I'm getting them.
cards.exUz: Bu poyabzallar bu hafta chegirmada, shuning uchun men ularni olaman.

cards.ex: That restaurant is too pricey for a casual dinner.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran oddiy kechki ovqat uchun juda qimmat.

cards.ex: They have strong brand loyalty; they only buy Apple products.
cards.exUz: Ularda brendga kuchli sodiqlik bor; ular faqat Apple mahsulotlarini sotib olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir brendni doimiy ravishda tanlash.

cards.ex: We live in a consumer society, always wanting more.
cards.exUz: Biz iste'mol jamiyatida yashaymiz, doimo ko'proq narsani xohlaymiz.

cards.ex: She's a real bargain hunter; she always finds the best deals.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy arzon izlovchi; u doimo eng yaxshi takliflarni topadi.

cards.ex: That store is a rip off; their prices are outrageous.
cards.exUz: Bu do'kon aldab sotadi; ularning narxlari juda yuqori.

cards.ex: I'm going to splash out on a new TV for my birthday.
cards.exUz: Men tug'ilgan kunim uchun yangi televizorga katta pul sarflamoqchiman.

cards.ex: We need to tighten our belts now that I lost my job.
cards.exUz: Men ishimni yo'qotganimdan keyin biz pulni tejashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: This laptop was expensive, but it's worth every penny.
cards.exUz: Bu noutbuk qimmat edi, lekin har tiyinga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Qimmat bo'lsa ham, foydali va sifatli.

cards.ex: I need to get a refund for this broken toaster.
cards.exUz: Men bu buzilgan tost uchun pulni qaytarib olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tovar qaytarilgani uchun pulni qaytarib olmoq.

cards.ex: I have terrible buyer's remorse after buying that car.
cards.exUz: Men bu mashinani sotib olganimdan keyin juda afsusdaman.

cards.ex: That book is out of stock; we'll have to order it.
cards.exUz: Bu kitob mavjud emas; biz uni buyurtma qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: I made a purchase online last night.
cards.exUz: Men kecha kechqurun internetda xarid qildim.

cards.ex: She's a shopaholic; she shops every day.
cards.exUz: U shopogolik; u har kuni xarid qiladi.

cards.ex: They're having a clearance sale to get rid of old stock.
cards.exUz: Ular eski zahiralarni yo'qotish uchun tugatish sotuvini o'tkazishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotlarni tezda sotish uchun chegirmali sotuv.

cards.ex: That company has a really catchy slogan.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniyaning juda esda qolarli shiori bor.

cards.ex: I want to get my money's worth out of this gym membership.
cards.exUz: Men bu sport zaliga a'zolikdan pulimni oqlashni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: To'langan pulga mos sifat va foyda olmoq.

cards.ex: It's always wise to compare prices before buying electronics.
cards.exUz: Elektronika sotib olishdan oldin har doim narxlarni solishtirish oqilona.
cards.uzDef: Turli do'konlarda bir xil narsaning narxlarini tekshirish.

cards.ex: This phone is great value for money.
cards.exUz: Bu telefon narxiga juda arziydi.

cards.ex: I wasn't convinced by their sales pitch.
cards.exUz: Men ularning sotuv nutqiga ishonmadim.

cards.ex: That's a high-end department store.
cards.exUz: Bu yuqori sifatli universal do'kon.

cards.ex: Use this discount code at checkout to save 10%.
cards.exUz: 10% tejash uchun bu chegirma kodidan to'lov vaqtida foydalaning.

cards.ex: I needed some retail therapy after a stressful day.
cards.exUz: Stressli kundan keyin menga xarid terapiyasi kerak edi.

cards.ex: We're on a budget, so we can't afford anything too expensive.
cards.exUz: Biz byudjetdamiz, shuning uchun biz juda qimmat narsalarni sotib ololmaymiz.

cards.ex: The customer service at that store is excellent.
cards.exUz: Bu do'kondagi mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish juda yaxshi.

cards.ex: That dress was a steal; I can't believe how cheap it was.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'ylak juda arzon edi; men uning qanchalik arzonligiga ishonmayman.

cards.ex: They have an early bird special at that restaurant.
cards.exUz: Bu restoranda erta qush aksiyasi bor.
